messages:
acme_integration: hey, after the model swap yesterday (llm-4b-v2 -> llm-4b-v3-quant) our downstream webhook started failing with strict JSON parsers. getting HTTP 400 and an error: "Invalid JSON: Unexpected token ',' at position 89". this started immediately after the canary.

violet_support: sorry for the trouble — can you paste the raw response body you received (the streamed chunks or final payload)? also which client parser are you using?

acme_integration: reproducible curl below. we hit the endpoint with structured output mode and the final body we see is invalid (trailing comma inside array/object). parser is ajv in node.

```bash
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.example/v1/generate \\n  -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" \\n  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \\n  -d '{"model":"llm-4b-v3-quant","mode":"json","prompt":"generate_order_json"}'
```

raw response body captured from our webhook (single line):

{"orderId":12345,"status":"confirmed","items":[{"sku":"X1","qty":2},],}

violet_support: that trailing comma definitely explains the ajv failure. thanks for the snippet. can you also share request headers (especially any streaming-related flags) and whether you saw chunked responses on the wire?

acme_integration: no special headers from our side, just the usual Content-Type and Authorization. we do process streaming responses but in this case the final assembled string already had the trailing comma. we captured it from our webhook logs (ingress before parsing).

samir_eng: tagging in — seeing a pattern in recent canary: structured-output templates that emit arrays were occasionally ending with an extra comma when the model produced a short, closed array. looks like a string-assembly bug in the streaming joiner for the quant path (llm-4b-v3-quant) where separators get appended even when the emitted chunk is the closing bracket. low risk to customers but high noise.

samir_eng: short repro we ran: request structured output with an array field and force the model to produce a short list. streaming mode on yields chunks: "items":[{"sku":"X1","qty":2}`, `,` and `]` — on certain chunk boundaries the joiner kept the comma and also re-emitted one when finalizing, ending up with `...2},,]` or `...2},]` depending on timing. our strict downstreams then fail.

violet_support: thanks. mitigation steps for customer: 1) pin model to llm-4b-v2 (previous) 2) disable streaming by including "stream":false in request body 3) post-process payload server-side to rtrim trailing commas as a temporary band-aid. please let us know which you prefer and we can apply tenant-level pin if needed.

acme_integration: pinning to v2 is fine for now — can you do that from your side? we can't change deployment quickly. also curious about ETA for a fix as streaming is important for us.

ops-bot: Incident created INC-2026-0453 assigned to samir_eng. Priority: P2. Canary id: c-20260316-07.

samir_eng: I will roll a fix to the streaming joiner that skips adding separators if the next chunk starts with a closing punctuation. plan: hotfix on runtime canary and then promote to stable if green. ETA for canary hotfix: 4 hours, full rollout in 24-48 hours if no regressions.

violet_support: done — I've pinned acme_integration to llm-4b-v2 at the control plane and notified them. we also provided the `stream:false` suggestion as a fallback.

acme_integration: confirmed tests look good on our side after pin. thanks for the quick help. please keep us posted on the rollout/fix so we can plan to move back to v3.

samir_eng: will update here after canary hotfix. next update in ~3-4 hours after we validate logs and run customers' sample prompts. apologies for the disruption.

violet_support: noted — queued a follow-up to re-check any other tenants using json-mode with v3-quant and short arrays.

acme_integration: one more datapoint — our parser also flagged errors for cases where enums were emitted as bare numbers vs strings after the swap (e.g., "priority": 1 -> sometimes now "priority": "1" ). not sure if related but filing here in case it's connected.

samir_eng: thanks — we'll include enum emission tests in the canary validation matrix. might be a separate tokenization/formatting regression but we'll cover it.

ops-bot: INC-2026-0453 status updated: investigating (samir_eng).
